quickStart.title: Check two JSON documents
quickStart.description: The schema requires an integer id. The first document passes; the second has a string where an integer is required. All sample data is included.
quickStart.note: Validation raises an error for a nonconforming document. `TRY` turns that error into `NULL`; `COALESCE` makes the result `false`. Validate a schema separately before using this pattern with your own data, because `TRY` also catches errors in the schema. The validator targets JSON Schema draft-07.

introduction.title: Check that JSON documents follow an agreed structure
paragraphs: A JSON Schema describes a document’s expected fields, types, and constraints. DuckDB can read JSON with different shapes; this extension adds an explicit check against the contract you choose.

Use it to check API payloads or incoming records before further processing. The validator targets JSON Schema draft-07 and can apply schema-defined defaults. Validation errors normally stop the query; the example shows how to turn invalid documents into a boolean result after checking the schema itself.
